osaka_panaf_african_restaurant_club.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog says allergy information is available. Rice dishes, stews and grilled meats are the places to ask; fried shrimp in kataifi, fritters, bread and pita are wheat-based.
osaka_panaf_african_restaurant_club.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options, but the buffet is centred on meat stews, kebabs and fried seafood and the dishes are not labelled in reviews.
osaka_panaf_african_restaurant_club.hours_raw: Sun–Thu and holidays 11:00–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Fri and Sat 11:00–22:30 and then as a club from 22:30 to 05:00; closed over the New Year (Tabelog). Buffet from 2 October 2026: lunch 11:00–15:00, ¥2,000 for 90 minutes (¥2,500 with soft drinks); dinner ¥3,800 for 120 minutes (with soft drinks ¥4,500, alcohol ¥5,500, craft beer ¥6,500); an African beer-garden course on the terrace ¥5,000 (Tabelog). Live music every day, from about 20:00 (Tabelog; October 2026). Reservations (Tabelog); the entry queue can be slow (October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 200 seats with sofas, a counter and a terrace; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu and English-speaking staff; kids menu (Tabelog). Opened 24 March 2026 (Tabelog).
osaka_panaf_african_restaurant_club.notes: [African · Amerikamura, the Expo's African restaurant, now a buffet with live music] The African restaurant that drew crowds at the 2025 Osaka Expo, reopened on the 7th floor of Big Step in Amerikamura and since October 2026 a buffet: ¥2,000 at lunch, ¥3,800 at dinner, with a terrace and live African music every night. Try the peanut-rich mafe stew, Kenyan kebab, kataifi shrimp and the rice dishes, and a baobab or bissap juice. Diners in 2026 found it great value and fun; some found the entry queue disorganised, the soups sour or the popular dishes gone at peak times. On Friday and Saturday nights it turns into a club until 5:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an African buffet restaurant with live performances, blending traditional African culture with contemporary flavours, with dishes that were a hit at the Expo; buffet from 2 October 2026; opened 24 March 2026. October 2026 reviewers describe it as the African restaurant from the Osaka Kansai Expo.
chef_bio.philosophy: Refined African dishes that break the stereotype of Africa (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "I especially loved the Mafe, a rich beef stew made with peanut butter, which had a wonderful buttery aroma." — October 2026, buffet with craft beer ¥6,500.
"The performers shared stories about their country's culture." — October 2026, the ¥2,500 lunch with drinks.
"There was a long line at the reception. It felt more like the operation was not well organized rather than a shortage of staff." — October 2026, Saturday lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): PANAF' African Restaurant & Club、アフリカ料理・ビュッフェ・ダイニングバー、西心斎橋1-6-14 BIG STEP 7F、Shinsaibashi 駅8番出口・Yotsubashi 駅5番出口から徒歩3分、日〜木・祝 11:00〜23:00、金土 11:00〜22:30・22:30〜5:00、年末年始休み、10月2日からビュッフェ (ランチ2,000円90分、ソフトドリンク飲み放題つき2,500円、ディナー3,800円120分、ソフトドリンク4,500円・アルコール5,500円・クラフトビール6,500円)、テラスのビアガーデンコース5,000円、毎日ライブ、カード・電子マネー・QR可、200席、テラス、禁煙、車椅子可、英語メニューと英語を話すスタッフ、アレルギー表示、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアンメニュー、キッズメニュー、2026年3月24日オープン、万博で人気の料理。口コミ(2026年10月): ケニアのケバブ、チェブジェン風の牛と野菜のご飯、タジン、ピーナッツバターの牛シチューのマフェ、豆と肉のトマト煮、ミートボール、カダイフ巻きのエビフライ、魚のフリット、唐揚げ、ヨーグルトのデザート、バオバブやビサップのジュース、受付の行列、スープが酸っぱい、料理がなくなるという声も。

osaka_yamatoya_honten_shimanouchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi is the plainest; fugu kara-age, sukiyaki and the sauces are wheat or soy based. The shop takes requests for children's meals (Tabelog).
osaka_yamatoya_honten_shimanouchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, fugu, kue, Kobe beef and Ise lobster kaiseki.
osaka_yamatoya_honten_shimanouchi.hours_raw: Daily lunch 11:00–16:30 (last lunch order 14:00) and dinner 17:00–21:30 (last order 20:00); open all year (Tabelog). Reservations; groups of 15–16 or more by phone; rooms for two hours (Tabelog). Kaiseki courses: Umai kaiseki ¥6,600, Ookini course ¥7,700, Tenkomori with fugu, Kobe beef and Ise lobster ¥13,200 (Tabelog). BYO drinks allowed; children's lunch sets and meals on request (Tabelog). Fully private rooms for 2 to 100; smoking only in a separate area (Tabelog). Menus in English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese and Korean, and staff who speak them (Tabelog).
osaka_yamatoya_honten_shimanouchi.notes: [Kaiseki · Shimanouchi, seasonal Kansai kaiseki by the Dotonbori River] A large Japanese restaurant (and inn) on the Dotonbori River just across Nipponbashi, with fully private rooms for anything from two to a hundred guests, popular for company trips and New Year parties. Courses follow the season: kue hot pot in winter, hamo in summer, Kobe beef, fugu, and a ¥13,200 boat-platter feast of fugu, Kobe beef and Ise lobster. Diners praise the sashimi and the private rooms; several found the service rushed or ordinary for the setting, and one found the abalone disappointing (July 2026). Menus in four languages; lunch and dinner daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: by the Dotonbori River, serving seasonal dishes from carefully selected ingredients so guests can taste Kansai's "shun"; rooms for groups of 2 to 100. An April 2026 reviewer describes staying at Yamatoya as a ryokan with a public bath; June 2026 reviewers came on a company trip.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; fugu and kue hot pots.

anecdotes.text: "I was particularly impressed by the Kue hot pot, which had a superb broth and wonderfully tender texture." — December 2024, the kue kaiseki at lunch.
"The MVP was the flounder wrapped in paper." — June 2026, a company trip.
"We also had abalone, but it tasted more like tokobushi." — July 2026, a company-trip dinner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 大和屋本店 (やまとやほんてん)、日本料理・ふぐ・かに、島之内2-17-4、Nippombashi 駅6番出口から徒歩3分、道頓堀川沿い、毎日11:00〜16:30 (昼の L.O.14:00)・17:00〜21:30 (L.O.20:00)、年中無休、予約可 (15名以上は電話)、個室は2時間、旨い会席6,600円 (鯛の薄造り、和牛すき焼きの小鍋)、おおきにコース7,700円 (神戸牛の炙り寿司)、天こ盛り13,200円 (ふぐ、神戸牛、伊勢海老)、2〜100名の完全個室、分煙、持ち込み可、子ども向けのランチセット、英語・中国語 (繁体字・簡体字)・韓国語のメニューとスタッフ、関西の旬、春は神戸牛、夏は鮎と鱧。口コミ(2024年12月〜2026年7月): クエ鍋の会席と雑炊、鱧会席8,800円、神戸牛の会席、ふぐのコース (刺身、唐揚げ、鉄板焼き)、刺身の盛り合わせ、カレイの紙包み焼き、旅館としての滞在、社員旅行、接客が慌ただしい・普通、アワビがトコブシのようだったという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese (traditional and simplified) and Korean, with staff who speak them (Tabelog).

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

osaka_osteria_pantera_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The fresh pasta, focaccia, pizza, lasagna and gratin are wheat-based; carpaccio, the fruit, prosciutto and burrata plate and the steak are where to ask.
osaka_osteria_pantera_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options; the reviewed dishes are mostly cheese, seafood and meat.
osaka_osteria_pantera_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 10:30–23:30: lunch 10:30–15:00, dinner 15:00–23:30; irregular closures (Tabelog). October 2026 diners give 08:00–23:00 with breakfast coffee and focaccia sandwiches. Reservations; cancelled if unreachable 30 minutes after the time (Tabelog). Lunch course from ¥2,000 with fresh pasta and unlimited bread (Tabelog; October 2026); weekday short course ¥3,800, Pantera course ¥5,000, special course with domestic beef fillet ¥7,200 (Tabelog). Over 50 wines; a sommelier (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR including Alipay (Tabelog). 34 seats with sofas; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi and outlets; children and strollers welcome; English menu and English-speaking staff; takeaway (Tabelog). Tabelog gives the opening day as 3 October 2025; an October 2026 diner says it reopened on 26 September 2026.
osaka_osteria_pantera_shinsaibashi.notes: [Italian · Shinsaibashi, an all-day osteria by Daimaru] A stylish osteria a minute from Daimaru Shinsaibashi, open from morning to late night, with fresh pasta at lunch and small plates and over 50 wines in the evening. Start with the four-cheese and honey focaccia and the fig, prosciutto and burrata plate, then a porcini or tomato-cream fresh pasta and the beef steak with porcini sauce. Lunch courses start at ¥2,000. Diners in October 2026, after it reopened, praised the food, the room and the help with surprise celebrations. English menu.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: fresh pasta at lunch and small plates and meat dishes with over 50 wines in the evening; courses for gatherings and dates; a sommelier. An October 2026 diner says it reopened on 26 September 2026 and now opens from 8:00 for breakfast.

anecdotes.text: "Osteria Pantera, an Italian restaurant in Shinsaibashi, has reopened on September 26th." — October 2026, gratin, carpaccio and steak.
"The pasta had a unique texture that I haven't experienced elsewhere" — October 2026, arrabbiata.
"They now offer a more affordable and casual lunch course, and it seems the menu has changed a bit since my last visit." — October 2026, pizza and fresh-pasta lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Osteria Pantera、イタリアン・パスタ・創作料理、心斎橋筋1-3-10 心斎橋井上ビル 1F、Shinsaibashi 駅5番出口から徒歩1分、Nagahoribashi 駅7番出口から3分、毎日10:30〜23:30 (ランチ10:30〜15:00、ディナー15:00〜23:30)、不定休、予約可 (30分連絡がなければキャンセル)、生パスタのランチコース2,000円から、平日のショートコース3,800円、パンテーラコース5,000円、国産牛フィレのスペシャルコース7,200円、50種以上のワイン、ソムリエ、カード・電子マネー・QR可、34席、禁煙、Wi-Fi、電源、子ども・ベビーカー可、英語メニューと英語を話すスタッフ、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアンメニュー、テイクアウト、オープン日は2025年10月3日。口コミ(2026年10月): 9月26日にリニューアルオープン、朝8時から、4種のチーズとはちみつのフォカッチャ、季節の果物と生ハムとブッラータ1,680円、ホタテの炙りカルパッチョ1,280円、エビとホタテのグラタン2,000円、国産牛のステーキのポルチーニソース2,980円、エビのトマトクリーム2,300円、ポルチーニのクリーム、アラビアータ、ラザニア、トリュフ塩のポテト、アフォガート。
